Baruipur Rape-Murder Case: Main Accused Killed in Police Encounter

The main accused in the rape and murder of a 12-year-old girl in Baruipur, West Bengal, has been killed in a police encounter. Police stated they took the accused, Prabhas Mondal, to the crime scene to recreate the events leading to the crime. The incident has raised questions and sparked debate regarding police action and justice.
